propositions: The regex pattern _OPERATOR_ATTESTED_TAG_RE must be widened to match both [non-codebase] and [operator-attested] tags with non-capturing alternation to preserve findall() list return type
Five consumers share the same compiled regex object, so widening the pattern propagates the change to all of them without requiring new branching logic

The fifth consumer in txn.py:547 has inverted semantics where a regex match exempts an unchecked AC item from blocking ticket close, so widening the matcher must also exempt [non-codebase]-tagged items
Widening the tag matcher must not break existing tests and must be preceded by ADR 0101 (S8) landing to formally define the [non-codebase] vocabulary

The non-capturing group requirement is critical because decide_ops.operator_attested_ac_texts uses findall(), which would return tuples instead of strings if groups capture, breaking Pass-3 enrichment
The criteria_routing.json text_all trigger at line 75 must be updated to match either spelling for consistent activation across both tag variants
